text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, our guest City-san
will be spending some time surviving on an uninhabited island~!”

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, City-san. If you could only bring one single item
to a deserted island,
what would you choose?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Just one, was it?

text_block_list.name: City on TV
text_block_list.text: "Well then, Trainer. Here's my—"

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text: "Today's shoot isn't about the hardcore reality of survival, but rather about capturing a person's true self within a unique environment—"

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text:
During filming, you'll need to follow the instructor's directions,
but other than that, you're free to spend your time as you please.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And that's that.
So we can sneak in some training in between, right?
choice_data_list: I see, so that's why you said "ore"...
I see, so that's why you said "watashi"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I must devise a menu that makes full use of this deserted island's environment, no matter what!
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to live up to City's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
In an environment like this, I have to be careful with skincare and moisturizing, but...
I wonder what's around here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That coconut I picked up earlier...
Well, looks like we could use it for oil at least.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“...Whoa, the sun's harsh.
I wonder if that leaf over there could work as a parasol?”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What do you think this is? ...Impromptu potpourri.
I stuffed some flowers into a container I found lying around, and it turned out surprisingly nice.

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text:
Cut! That's wonderful~
From a modeling perspective, deserted island life really pops!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, hah,
The footing is terrible...! The strain is brutal...!
choice_data_list: Keep going! One more to go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright...!
Time to spurt...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Living a deserted island life worthy of a model,
fitting in training whenever possible.
The photoshoot progressed smoothly. However—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is this?
There's no one here. No gear, no boat...!
choice_data_list: Is something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, did they really have to leave us behind?
Or are things so bad they didn't even notice we were gone...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My phone is... still out of service, just like when we arrived.
Living on a deserted island like this is no joke, you know.
choice_data_list: No, I'll definitely find a way back home.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, we've got nothing on us.
It's not like we have any leads.
choice_data_list: That may be so, but I won't let your dream end here!
That may be so, but I won't let your dream end here!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――……
Ugh, talk about overbearing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, sure, of course I wanna
keep running in races, but still."
choice_data_list: It's not too late to reach a conclusion after you've struggled a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............
Well, you have a point.
choice_data_list: Either way, let's keep up the training.
First, we have to prioritize survival...
Times like these are when we shouldn't forget to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
No matter the situation, conditioning our bodies is a must, right?
choice_data_list: If we use driftwood and vines, we could probably make equipment too!
If we use driftwood and vines, we could probably make equipment too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds good.
If we get creative, we might even be able to set up a whole course, right?
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's find a good spot!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew.
I think it's finally starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Whether we wait for help or
try to escape, it won't matter if we collapse."
choice_data_list: First, let's make some daily necessities and a shelter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Got it. Or so I'd like to say, but do you even know how to make it?
choice_data_list: I prepped by watching survival videos before coming, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Well, let's see what you've got then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew.
I think it's finally starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Recreation...? I thought you'd say something like,
"First, let's get all the necessities together!"
choice_data_list: Mental management is more important than you'd think.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah. To be honest, I almost panicked from the shock myself.
choice_data_list: I could probably make stuff like swings or a target toss and such.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, what are you, a kid?
...Though, it's not bad."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew.
I think it's finally starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, the edge might need more reinforcement. Let me give it another go later.
choice_data_list: Yeah, if we're doing this, let's go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to being engrossed in the work,
Gold City had completely regained her spirits.
At this rate, the future is surely bright.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, pfft.
You're completely covered in mud.
choice_data_list: That goes both ways.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah. Fans of 'Pretty City'
might be pretty shocked if they saw this.
choice_data_list: No, you look cool when you're giving it your all.
No, seeing you work so hard is really cool.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, the reason I became this way was—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, forget I said anything.
I'm gonna go grab some water.
choice_data_list: Huh? Wait, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... That's not like me at all. What am I even saying?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...'The one thing you'd bring to an uninhabited island'—huh."

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand!
Prank successful~~~!!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, sorry for startling you!
But after seeing cool City-san burn with such passion,
everyone's bound to fall in love with her all over again!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............
...I see.
Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: ...I can't believe it was a hidden camera prank.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... let's just say it turned out okay.
At least we can get back in one piece.
choice_data_list: Though, if possible, I kind of wanted to make it all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the unfinished fruit of our joint efforts.
While one could simply chalk it up to a good memory, I can't help feeling a sense of regret.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. But they said it's about time to pack up.
choice_data_list: I guess this is the end of our deserted island life, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it wasn't so bad after all.
Though I'd hate being left behind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If there's no trouble,
then coming back should be fine, right?
